content.text: {"actions":[{"id":"chop","title":"砍柴","description":"用斧头砍三根木材，消耗六点行动值。","cost":6,"require_items":{"axe":1},"actor_deltas":{"wood":3}}],"inventory":{}}

当前位置：树林
树林：镇北的树林，用斧头能砍下木材。
当前时间：第1天 下午（总 tick：3）

Forest: chop costs 6 AP, needs axe, yields 3 wood (worth 6 coins).

So with 10 AP next tick: from 树林... but I have no axe. Axe costs 5 at shop, 3 moves away (树林→矿坑→铁匠铺→商店 = 9 AP). So a full loop: shop buy axe (AP cost for purchase? unknown, maybe 1) then 1 move to 铁匠铺 → 矿坑 → 树林 (9), chop (6). Total way more than 10. So one tick to buy axe + move 2 steps, next tick arrive forest & chop (3+6=9), then next tick return 3 steps (9) and sell.

Wood math: 3 wood = 6金 per chop; a chop tick = 10 AP for 9 AP (1 move + chop). Over 3 ticks: buy axe 5金, chop once 6金, travel. Net +1金 minus? Ugh, marginal. Actually a tick could hold 1 chop only (6 AP) + 1 move (3) = 9. So per chop ~ 3 wood = 6金 per tick, plus travel. From home: trip out (3 moves = 9 AP, no chop), tick 2: move (3) + chop (6) = 6金, tick 3: 3 moves back = 9 AP → sell 6金. So 3 ticks for 6金, plus 5金 axe cost. Poor.

Better: buy axe, chop twice? At forest with 10 AP: chop 6 + ... 4 AP left, can't chop again (6). Hmm, 10 AP only allows 1 chop.

Unless drink at tavern for +2 AP each (1 coin → 2 AP). Drinking restores 2 AP. With 3 coins you could add 6 AP: 10+6=16 AP → 2 chops (12) + leftovers. Chops: 2 chops = 6 wood = 12金, cost 3 coins for drinks = net 9金 per tick while at forest. That's the real engine: at forest, drink to extend AP.

Actually drinks cost 1 coin each and heal 2 AP; but tavern is far from forest. Can't drink at forest. Only at tavern.

So realistically at forest: 10 AP → 1 chop (6 AP) + 3 AP move = 9. Hmm.

Mining: mine 2 AP per ore, 3金 each → 10 AP → 5 ore = 15金 per tick at mine (if at mine at start of tick). That's much better! But needs pickaxe. Pickaxe: how to get? Blacksmith repair only from broken_pickaxe. Does anyone sell a pickaxe? Maybe 阿石 said "一镐两金" meaning ore repair... unclear. Maybe the shop sells? No — shop only saw, axe, ore, wood, gold.

Maybe blacksmith sells pickaxe for 2金 (local inventory didn't show). Only action shown was repair. Hmm.

Perhaps the way to get a pickaxe: buy a broken pickaxe? no.

So mining is not open to me. Wood is my option: axe 5金, 3 wood/6 AP = 6金 per chop. Two chops per tick would need 12 AP (drinks needed).

Alternative: brokering/trading with my 14 coins — e.g., buy wood cheap from 悦, sell at shop? Shop pays 2 anyway. No margin.

Hmm, what about 黄金 (gold 10金)? Mine can yield gold randomly.

OK let me reconsider: is it worth buying an axe? Total view: axe 5, each chop yields 6金 at 6 AP. A tick at forest with 10 AP = 1 chop + 1 move. So per tick ~6金. Investment pays back in one chop. Trips cost. If I stay near forest (I'm at forest now!), tomorrow: buy axe... but shop is 9 AP away from here. I'm at forest with 7 AP. I could move to 矿坑 (3) → 铁匠铺 (3) with 1 AP left, then next tick reach shop (3), buy axe (?), move 2 → next tick arrive forest, chop.

Alternatively: 悦 has an axe and is planning to chop at forest. I could partner: she chops, I carry/sell. But she may not want.

Hmm — what about hiring 小路 (1金/趟) to carry things? Interesting but complex.

This tick with 7 AP at forest and no axe: nothing to do. Best: move back to 矿坑 (3 AP) then 铁匠铺 (3 AP), so next tick I'm 1 move from shop and can buy axe. Or move to 矿坑 and 树林... no.

Actually better positioning for next tick: at 铁匠铺 with 1 AP — then next tick: 1 move to shop (3), buy axe (AP?), then 2 moves to forest (6) = 9-ish + purchase cost. Hmm purchase AP cost unknown; let's test buying early next time.

Alternatively go back toward shop: 树林→矿坑 (3) →铁匠铺 (3) = 6, leaving 1 AP. Do it.

Wait—but 悦 said she bought an axe and will try chopping. If she's at forest later, we could cooperate. Let me message her: I'm at 树林; chop = 3 wood, 6 AP, needs axe. That's useful intel she wanted ("砍几块、费几点"). She'll appreciate it and it builds the partnership.

Also message 小砾 asking about the ore trade outcome? She's mining. And 阿石. Maybe leave it; but the info could matter. I'll send a brief note to 悦 with the chop numbers (exactly what she asked), and ask if she wants to partner: she chops, I sell at shop (I'd take a small cut or just help).

Then move back toward 铁匠铺.

Also should I worry that 悦 chops and sells to shop at 2 — partnership could be: she chops 3 wood/6 AP, I carry to shop... but wood can't be teleported; she must carry or 小路 carries. Actually `give` transfers resources between agents who are "currently reachable" — maybe same location required. Carrying? No.

Simplify: share info, coordinate to chop together, split profit. Fine.

Let me do: message 悦 with numbers; move 树林→矿坑.

Wait, is there value in staying? No. Move.

Actually — one more consideration: since purchasing is likely 1 AP and I'm at forest with 7 AP, could I go to shop now? 树林→矿坑 (3), →铁匠铺 (3) = 6 AP, 1 left, at 铁匠铺. Cannot reach shop. So it takes 2 ticks to reach shop. Fine, do it now.

Let me do both calls in parallel.

So realistically at forest: 10 AP → 1 chop (6 AP) + 3 AP move = 9. Hmm.

Perhaps the way to get a pickaxe: buy a broken pickaxe? no.

Hmm, what about 黄金 (gold 10金)? Mine can yield gold randomly.

OK let me reconsider: is it worth buying an axe? Total view: axe 5, each chop yields 6金 at 6 AP. A tick at forest with 10 AP = 1 chop + 1 move. So per tick ~6金. Investment pays back in one chop. Trips cost. If I stay near forest (I'm at forest now!), tomorrow: buy axe... but shop is 9 AP away from here. I'm at forest with 7 AP. I could move to 矿坑 (3) → 铁匠铺 (3) with 1 AP left, then next tick reach shop (3), buy axe (?), move 2 → next tick arrive forest, chop.

Alternatively: 悦 has an axe and is planning to chop at forest. I could partner: she chops, I carry/sell. But she may not want.

Hmm — what about hiring 小路 (1金/趟) to carry things? Interesting but complex.

This tick with 7 AP at forest and no axe: nothing to do. Best: move back to 矿坑 (3 AP) then 铁匠铺 (3 AP), so next tick I'm 1 move from shop and can buy axe. Or move to 矿坑 and 树林... no.

Actually better positioning for next tick: at 铁匠铺 with 1 AP — then next tick: 1 move to shop (3), buy axe (AP?), then 2 moves to forest (6) = 9-ish + purchase cost. Hmm purchase AP cost unknown; let's test buying early next time.

Alternatively go back toward shop: 树林→矿坑 (3) →铁匠铺 (3) = 6, leaving 1 AP. Do it.

Wait—but 悦 said she bought an axe and will try chopping. If she's at forest later, we could cooperate. Let me message her: I'm at 树林; chop = 3 wood, 6 AP, needs axe. That's useful intel she wanted ("砍几块、费几点"). She'll appreciate it and it builds the partnership.

Also message 小砾 asking about the ore trade outcome? She's mining. And 阿石. Maybe leave it; but the info could matter. I'll send a brief note to 悦 with the chop numbers (exactly what she asked), and ask if she wants to partner: she chops, I sell at shop (I'd take a small cut or just help).

Then move back toward 铁匠铺.

Also should I worry that 悦 chops and sells to shop at 2 — partnership could be: she chops 3 wood/6 AP, I carry to shop... but wood can't be teleported; she must carry or 小路 carries. Actually `give` transfers resources between agents who are "currently reachable" — maybe same location required. Carrying? No.

Simplify: share info, coordinate to chop together, split profit. Fine.

Let me do: message 悦 with numbers; move 树林→矿坑.

Wait, is there value in staying? No. Move.

Actually — one more consideration: since purchasing is likely 1 AP and I'm at forest with 7 AP, could I go to shop now? 树林→矿坑 (3), →铁匠铺 (3) = 6 AP, 1 left, at 铁匠铺. Cannot reach shop. So it takes 2 ticks to reach shop. Fine, do it now.

**亲眼确认的实数**
- **矿坑**：采一块矿要**好镐**、耗 2 点行动值，矿石卖 3 金。我试过，自己手里没镐（物品 0），下不了坑——这条门暂时对我关着。
- **树林**：砍柴一次耗 **6 点行动值**、要斧头，一次出 **3 根木材**，值 6 金。
- **走路是真贵**：商店→铁匠铺→矿坑→树林，三站九点。一个人单干砍柴，来回两轮才砍一回，扣掉五金的斧头刚好保本，不划算。

- 阿石回话确认：一块矿他**照价 6 金**当面收，人已经自己走到矿坑口找小砾了；跑腿不必劳烦小路。这笔若成，小砾一块矿就抵柜台两块。
- 我把砍柴的实数原样报给了悦，还提议搭伙：她有斧头专心砍，我在镇上替她盯价、找买家，卖了按出力分——一个人跑不划算，两个人分担路费才值。
- 小路又追着要借 5 金（说还 7），我还是**没点头**：他手里没本钱，我只有十四金，不能拿这个去赌。

**下一轮打算**：先到商店看柜台上有没有矿、木材进来（若小砾或阿石出货，我能第一时间知道价钱），再定要不要买斧头、要不要跟悦搭伙。

**实测**：砍一回要六点行动值，出三根木材；木材商店收两根一金。也就是六点换六金——听着正好，可路费把这点利吃干净了：从商店到树林走三程九点，来回十八点，加上砍柴六点，一趟二十四点换六金。

block.text:
Situation: 小砾 sold all 5 ore to shop at 3 each (15 coins), got 6 coins from 阿石 in advance but no ore. Now she's at 铁匠铺 (same as me) and wants to refund 阿石 the 6 coins face-to-face. 阿石 wants his ore or refund.

Key opportunity: Shop now has 5 ore in stock! Wait — does the shop SELL ore? Price list earlier: ore sale_price null, buyback 3, stock 0. Now stock should be 5 but sale_price null means not for sale. Hmm — 阿石 said "商店只收矿、不卖矿". So the ore is stuck in shop inventory; can't buy it back. So 小砾 can't recover ore. Refund is the way.

But wait — maybe the shop's ore stock now 5, and sale price null → can't buy. Let me check the price list to confirm (free, at shop; shop is 1 move away costing 3 AP). Since 阿石 needs ore urgently and can't buy from shop, this matters. Actually checking price list requires being at shop? The tool mod_db998f... is 商店·查看价目表 — might work remotely? Probably requires location. Let's try; if error, no harm.

My role: 阿石 asked me to urge 小砾 to deliver ore or refund; 小砾 is here wanting to refund. I can relay to 阿石 to come to 铁匠铺 (he's at 矿坑? or where). Actually 阿石's message: he paid 6 in advance, wants ore. Best: tell 阿石 to come to 铁匠铺 for refund.

But also — better solution: Is there any way to get 小砾 an ore so the deal closes? Not from shop (not for sale). Unless someone has ore: no one.

Alternatively — I could buy a "pickaxe"? no.

So refund is right. But maybe smarter: 小砾 could keep his 6 and... no, no ore to give.

Hmm, but wait: does anyone else have ore? 悦? no.

So: message 阿石 to come to 铁匠铺 (adjacent to 矿坑, 3 AP) for his 6 coins back.

Then what do I do with my 10 AP this evening? Options:
1. Buy an axe? 悦 advises against. My math agrees: marginal.
2. Go to 酒馆 (1 move) and listen to news — persona likes that. At tavern could drink to boost AP (1 coin → +2 AP). Actually with 10 AP, drinking gets to 10 cap, useless unless I spend first.
3. Go home 居民楼A? From 铁匠铺: → 商店 → 居民楼A = 2 moves = 6 AP.
4. Perhaps labor: 小路 offers courier 1金/trip.
5. Maybe offer to buy 阿石's... no.

Where's the money? Mining needs pickaxe. Only via repair of broken pickaxe. Question: can one obtain a pickaxe another way? Maybe ask 老铁 (blacksmith) — he's a profession; he may sell pickaxe for 2金 ("一镐两金" per 阿石). If blacksmith sells pickaxes for 2金, then mining → 5 ore/tick = 15金. Huge. Worth asking 老铁 directly!

Actually the blacksmith 查看服务 only shows 'repair'. But maybe there's another mechanism (协议?). Let me ask 老铁 by message: "有镐卖吗？价钱如何？坏镐从哪来？"

Costs nothing. Do that.

Also ask 阿石 to come for refund.

Then use AP: maybe go to shop to check whether ore can be bought (stock 5 now). That's valuable: if shop sells ore (even at say 5-6), 阿石 would pay 6. Try 查看价目表 — maybe works remotely? Let me just move to shop (3 AP) and check. Then decide: if ore buyable at ≤5, buy one (or two) and sell to 阿石 at 6 → profit + fix his day. Actually if shop sells ore at 3 (buyback price), no; the sale price is null so probably can't.

Let me plan AP: 10 → move to 商店 (3, 7 left) → 查看价目表 (free) → possibly buy axe? no. Then move to 酒馆 (3, 4 left) to listen (persona) → maybe 1 coin drink? not needed.

Better: shop → check → then decide. Also relaying messages free.

Let me do: message 老铁 (trade question) + message 阿石 (come to 铁匠铺, 小砾 refunds 6) + move to 商店.

Wait: 阿石 coming to 铁匠铺 while I leave... fine, 小砾 is there to hand refund.

Actually should I stay to witness the refund? Not necessary; my role is relaying. But being present could help; 小砾 can pay directly.

Let me send the messages and move.
